title: SDD Framework STATE.json
description: Machine-readable state for the SDD Framework pipeline.

phase.description: Current pipeline phase or blocked state.

next_step.description: Next concrete action for an agent or operator.

spec.description: Path to the active spec artifact.

plan.description: Path to the active implementation plan artifact.

branch.description: Git branch carrying the active work.

worktree.description: Filesystem path to the active worktree.

last_commit.description: Last commit SHA or abbreviated SHA observed by the pipeline.

last_agent.description: Agent or operator that last changed pipeline state.

last_update.description: Last state update timestamp in ISO 8601 UTC form.

lock.description: Advisory multi-agent lock with a TTL.

started_at.description: Lock acquisition timestamp in ISO 8601 UTC form.

retry_count.description: Consecutive retry count for the current phase/action.

last_error.description: Most recent pipeline error, or null when clear.

flavor.description: Pipeline flavor controlling applicable phases and gates.

handoff_backend.description: Backend used for handoff and discussion records.
